### Tooltip

<ApiTable kind="props" :items='[
  {
    "name": "defaultOpen",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The open state of the tooltip when it is initially rendered.\nUse when you do not need to control its open state.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "open",
    "type": "boolean",

    "description": "<p>The controlled open state of the tooltip.</p>"
  },
  {

    "type": "number",

    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Override the duration given to the <code>Provider</code> to customise\nthe open delay for a specific tooltip.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disableHoverableContent",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Prevents Tooltip.Content from remaining open when hovering.\nDisabling this has accessibility consequences. Inherits\nfrom Tooltip.Provider.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disableClosingTrigger",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, clicking on trigger will not close the content.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disabled",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, disable tooltip</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "ignoreNonKeyboardFocus",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Prevent the tooltip from opening if the focus did not come from\nthe keyboard by matching against the <code>:focus-visible</code> selector.\nThis is useful if you want to avoid opening it when switching\nbrowser tabs or closing a dialog.</p>"
  }
